Level 17 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Ability to use a Holy Symbol or Druidic Focus as a Spellcasting Focus
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 4
Order: Empower

A place of solace and healing.

Sanctum Charm. After you spend a Long Rest in your Bastion, you gain a magical Charm that lasts for 7 days or until you use it, letting you cast Heal once without expending a spell slot. You can't gain this Charm again while you still have it.

Empower: Fortifying Rites. The hirelings perform daily rites for you or another character you name, who needn't be in the Bastion. For 7 days, each time the beneficiary finishes a Long Rest, they gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your level.

Sanctum Recall. While the Sanctum exists, you always have Word of Recall prepared, and you can make your Sanctum its destination. One creature of your choice that arrives there through the spell gains the benefit of a Heal spell.
